items.venueLong: Main track, regular paper · Springer LNAI · CORE B
items.title: A Point-in-Time Audit of Graph-Snapshot Leakage in GNN Stock Selection
items.takeaway: In GNN stock selection, a graph built from the final snapshot seems to beat graphs built only from information available at each date. The gap disappears once several random seeds are used and the result is compared with random graphs that keep the same node degrees. Future information can leak through the graph, but the models do not use it.
items.summary: A performance gap between a snapshot graph and a point-in-time graph is routinely taken as evidence of look-ahead leakage. Often it is not. We test two kinds of graph and three model classes, controlling for seed luck and for graph stability. No model shows leakage that survives these controls: one apparent positive is exactly matched by a random graph with the same node degrees and disappears when the graph is sparsified; the other comes from a single seed and flips sign across five seeds. A leakage source does exist: edges that appear only in the final snapshot are more predictive of future returns. The models simply do not exploit it.
items.scale: 13F filings 2013–2026 · 2 graph modalities × 3 model classes · multi-seed + degree-preserved nulls + sparsity sweep + BH-FDR

items.title: ProbeShift: Predicting Probe-Direction Rotation from Stability is Largely a Sampling-Noise Floor
items.takeaway: A probe's stability appears to predict how much its direction rotates under a semantic shift that keeps the labels unchanged (ρ = 0.945). But it predicts a placebo with no shift at least as well (ρ = 0.966). Only one of seven candidate signals passes this check.
items.summary: Linear probes are attractive as label-free tools for evaluating models on out-of-distribution data, but a probe's direction rotates under a semantic shift, even when the labels stay the same. If an in-distribution signal and the shift it is meant to predict share the same finite-sample noise, a simple correlation between them is unreliable. We propose a check we call the symmetric null: an independent placebo with zero shift, used as a fake target. Under this check the headline result turns out to be circular: in-distribution stability predicts rotation at ρ = 0.945 and the placebo at ρ = 0.966. Of seven candidate signals, only one predicts the real shift better than it predicts the placebo; in a second family of signals on the same probes, none does.
items.scale: 12 concepts from 14 datasets · 7 models × 5 seeds · 472 configurations · 7 candidate signals · every headline number recomputes on CPU in seconds

items.venueLong: Resources and Evaluation track · Springer LNCS
items.title: Same Exam, Different Scores: A Tokenizer-Grounded Audit of Evaluation-Protocol Sensitivity on Chinese Benchmarks
items.takeaway: Using only the tokenizers, before running any model, we predicted that 12 of 64 model and label-set combinations would break the standard first-token scoring method. All 64 predictions were confirmed. Where it breaks, the ranking reflects the scoring method, not the model.
items.summary: Multiple-choice benchmarks are usually scored by comparing the model's probabilities for the first token of each answer label. For many Chinese models this is mathematically undefined: when the tokenizer maps all four answer labels to the same first token, the “answer” is decided by how ties are broken, not by the model. Which model and label-set pairs are affected follows from the tokenizer alone, so it can be predicted on a laptop CPU before any GPU run. We pre-registered these predictions and all 64 were confirmed on the real runs. The paper's only statistical test is on the negative control, where the two scoring methods show no significant difference (p = 0.453), not on the 12 broken cases, whose outcome is fixed by construction, so a test there would prove nothing.
items.scale: 18 checkpoints · 7 tokenizer families · 12,925 items · ~2.5M released scoring records · smoke test ≈ 5 s

items.title: Grounding or Lexical Overlap? A Matched-Pair Study of Internals-Based Context-Faithfulness Probes
items.takeaway: In the standard extractive setup, faithfulness labels track simple word overlap almost perfectly (r = 0.99), so a grounding probe may just be matching strings. A matched-pair design cuts this confound in half, and on RAGTruth the probe does worse than an NLI model and plain word overlap.
items.summary: In the standard extractive setup, the faithfulness label correlates with word overlap at r = 0.99, so a grounding probe can succeed simply by matching strings. A matched-pair construction reduces this correlation to r = 0.50, and on RAGTruth the probe direction scores below both NLI and word overlap.
items.scale: 4 model families · matched-pair design · RAGTruth + NQ-Swap · single A100

items.title: PCP: A Controlled Benchmark for Pragmatic Intention Recognition in Clinical Communication
items.takeaway: Eleven systems score 98.7–99.8% on the controlled split but only 79.7–90.6% on items grounded in external real-world text, so the controlled score was measuring how the benchmark was built.
items.summary: Eleven systems come within a point or two of the ceiling on the controlled split (98.7–99.8%) but drop to 79.7–90.6% once the items are grounded in external real-world text. This gap is the main finding: a broad controlled test can hide exactly the difficulty that close distractors reveal, so a benchmark that reports only the controlled score is measuring how it was built.
items.scale: 3,533 items across three splits · 11 systems · 388,630 scored calls · 2,499 blind-validated items

items.venueLong: 主会长文 · Springer LNAI · CCF-C
items.title: A Point-in-Time Audit of Graph-Snapshot Leakage in GNN Stock Selection
items.takeaway: 在 GNN 选股任务中，用期末快照构建的图看起来优于只用当期信息构建的图。但换用多个随机种子、并与保持节点度数的随机图对比后，这一优势消失了。未来信息确实可能通过图泄漏，但模型并没有利用它。
items.summary: 快照图和逐时点图之间的性能差距，常被直接当作前视泄漏的证据，但很多时候并非如此。我们在两种图、三类模型上控制了随机种子带来的偶然性和图的稳定性，没有任何模型表现出在这些控制下仍然成立的泄漏：一个看似存在泄漏的结果，与保持节点度数的随机图得到的结果完全相同，图稀疏化后也随之消失；另一个只出现在单个种子上，换成五个种子后连正负号都不稳定。泄漏源确实存在：只出现在期末快照里的边，对未来收益的预测力更强。但模型并没有用到它。
items.scale: 13F 持仓 2013–2026 · 2 种图模态 × 3 类模型 · 多种子 + 保度数零模型 + 稀疏化扫描 + BH-FDR

items.title: ProbeShift: Predicting Probe-Direction Rotation from Stability is Largely a Sampling-Noise Floor
items.takeaway: 探针的稳定性看似能预测数据发生语义漂移时探针方向会旋转多少（ρ = 0.945），但它预测一个完全没有漂移的安慰剂至少同样准（ρ = 0.966）。7 个候选信号中只有 1 个通过了这项检验。
items.summary: 线性探针不需要标注就能从模型激活中读出概念，因此常被用作分布外评估工具；但即使标签不变，探针方向也会在语义漂移下发生旋转。如果一个只用分布内数据算出的信号，和它要预测的漂移量共享同一份有限样本噪声，两者之间的简单相关就不可靠。我们提出一种检验方法，称为「对称零假设」：用一个独立的、零漂移的安慰剂充当假目标。在这一检验下，原本的结论其实是循环的：分布内稳定性预测旋转的 ρ = 0.945，预测安慰剂的 ρ = 0.966。7 个候选信号中只有 1 个预测真实漂移的效果高于预测安慰剂的效果；在同一批探针上的另一类信号中，一个都没有。
items.scale: 12 个概念（14 个数据集）· 7 个模型 × 5 个种子 · 472 个配置 · 7 个候选信号 · 关键数字均可在 CPU 上秒级复算

items.venueLong: Resources and Evaluation 方向 · Springer LNCS · CCF-C
items.title: Same Exam, Different Scores: A Tokenizer-Grounded Audit of Evaluation-Protocol Sensitivity on Chinese Benchmarks
items.takeaway: 不运行任何模型、只看 tokenizer，我们预测出 64 个「模型 × 选项标签集」组合中有 12 个会让常用的首 token 打分法失效。64 项预测全部得到验证。在这些情况下，排名反映的是打分方法，而不是模型本身。
items.summary: 多选题评测通常通过比较模型给各选项标签首个 token 的概率来打分。但对许多中文模型来说，这种做法在数学上没有定义：如果 tokenizer 把四个选项标签都映射到同一个首 token，最终的「答案」取决于平局时按什么规则取舍，而不是模型本身。哪些模型和标签集组合会出问题，只取决于 tokenizer，因此可以在跑 GPU 之前用笔记本电脑的 CPU 预测出来。我们在运行前预注册了这些预测，在真实运行中 64 项全部命中。论文唯一的统计检验放在阴性对照上（两种打分方法没有显著差异，p = 0.453），而不是那 12 个失效组合上，因为它们的结果在构造上就已确定，检验没有意义。
items.scale: 18 个检查点 · 7 个 tokenizer 家族 · 12,925 道题 · 公开约 250 万条打分记录 · smoke test ≈ 5 秒

items.venueLong: GroundLM 研讨会 · 独立作者
items.title: Grounding or Lexical Overlap? A Matched-Pair Study of Internals-Based Context-Faithfulness Probes
items.takeaway: 在标准的抽取式设定下，忠实性标签与简单的词语重叠高度相关（r = 0.99），所谓的 grounding 探针可能只是在做字符串匹配。匹配对设计把这一混淆减半；在 RAGTruth 上，探针方向的表现不如 NLI 模型和单纯的词语重叠。
items.summary: 在标准的抽取式设定下，忠实性标签与词语重叠的相关系数高达 r = 0.99，因此 grounding 探针可能只靠字符串匹配就取得好成绩。匹配对构造把这一相关降到 r = 0.50；在 RAGTruth 上，探针方向的得分低于 NLI 和词语重叠。
items.scale: 4 个模型家族 · 匹配对设计 · RAGTruth + NQ-Swap · 单卡 A100

items.venueLong: 第 3 届 LUHME 研讨会 · 独立作者
items.title: PCP: A Controlled Benchmark for Pragmatic Intention Recognition in Clinical Communication
items.takeaway: 11 个系统在受控子集上得分 98.7–99.8%，但在外部真实语料上只有 79.7–90.6%。可见受控分数衡量的其实是基准本身的构造方式。
items.summary: 11 个系统在受控子集上的得分都接近满分（98.7–99.8%），但题目换成外部真实语料后，跌到 79.7–90.6%。这个落差就是论文的主要发现：宽泛的受控测试恰好会掩盖相近干扰项所暴露的难度；只报告受控分数的基准，测到的其实是它自己的构造方式。
items.scale: 3,533 条题目 · 三个子集 · 11 个系统 · 388,630 次打分调用 · 2,499 条盲验证
